prompts.arena: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a wide gameplay art-direction look test for an angled top-down 3D arena run-and-gun wave survival game in an abandoned sci-fi scrapyard. Render like an actual readable stylized game screenshot, orthographic camera about 55 degrees downward, not cinematic key art. Open dusty desaturated concrete arena with embedded rail strips and sparse low barriers; piles of scrap, wrecked machinery and industrial lamps confined to the perimeter. One small but clearly readable player near center wearing a cream armored jacket, teal full helmet, large boots, compact battery backpack; holding a chunky squared scrap rifle with thick barrel and cyan power cell. Around 14 rust-orange rogue industrial biped robots converge in loose clusters with wedge heads and heavy clamp fists. Keep player and robots approximately 65-90 pixels tall within a 1536x1024 composition to test gameplay readability, leaving lots of traversable space. Some brief pale cyan rifle tracers and small impact sparks, one floating cyan industrial powerup cartridge with a bold lightning symbol in a clear opening. Chunky three-dimensional silhouettes, matte painted metal, broad posterized texture shading, restrained wear, no micro-detail. Enemies recognizable as machines with human-like limbs, not animals. Clear warm enemy / cool player separation, grounded daylight, no bloom fog or dramatic depth of field. No UI, no text, no title, no logos. This is a visual concept, not a finished playable screenshot.
prompts.scavenger: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: isolated 3D character production reference. Use the supplied scrapyard gameplay image as palette and identity reference for its cream-and-teal PLAYER ONLY. Produce one full-body scavenger, straight-on orthographic front view in strict horizontal T-pose: both arms straight level with shoulders, palms down, legs straight slightly apart, boots level. Whole figure centered with at least 8 percent margin, arm span approximately equal to stature; six head heights tall, shoulders just over two heads wide, large hands and boots, thick limbs. Cream industrial armored jacket over charcoal trousers, teal closed helmet with dark visor, cream shoulder armor, teal forearm guards, heavy boots and compact attached teal battery backpack. No weapon, no handheld item, no floating accessories, no wires. Chunky matte painted 3D game asset with broad posterized shading and very restrained wear; simplify the reference's tiny surface details. Isolated on perfectly uniform light lavender-grey background RGB 224 224 232; no floor, no contact shadow, no cast shadow, no horizon, no vignette. Painted self-shading on body is allowed. Exactly one character, no inset views, no lettering. Anatomically humanoid and riggable. Square image at least 1024px.
prompts.rusher: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE isolated production reference of a rust-orange industrial rusher robot from the supplied scrapyard scene. Preserve orange wedge-shaped head, dark narrow sensor face, round shoulder housings, clamp hands and chunky industrial boots, but adapt to a fully upright humanoid skeleton with distinct head, torso, pelvis, two arms and two legs. Approximately five head heights tall, arm span equal to total height. Strict front orthographic view, T-pose, arms perfectly straight and horizontal at shoulder height, legs straight with small gap, feet level. Thick upper arms and forearms of similar length, simple broad mitten-like three-jaw clamps with no delicate fingers or thin wires. Clear hip and knee articulation, solid covered joints. Orange shoulder shells and chest, charcoal joint sections, muted ochre boots, tiny warm amber face sensor (no cyan). Chunky matte painted 3D game art, broad posterized shading, restrained edge wear, no fine grime. Whole character contained with generous 8 percent margin all around on a perfectly flat light lavender grey RGB 224 224 232 background. No floor or ground shadow, no gradient, no detached objects, no weapon, no labels, no inset views. Single square image at least 1024px. Reference scene is style/identity reference only; do not reproduce scene or other subjects.
prompts.rifle: Use case: stylized-concept. Single isolated sci-fi scrap rifle 3D game prop production reference matching the supplied scrapyard gameplay scene's player weapon and cream teal color language. Three-quarter view slightly from above showing side and top, stock left and muzzle right. Compact chunky squared charcoal receiver, cream casing panels, muted teal rear stock, thick short barrel shroud, one recessed cyan rectangular power cell on the visible side, sturdy pistol grip and chunky foregrip, clearly visible muzzle. Bold low-detail silhouette and broad matte painted posterized shading; a few large chips only. No realism microdetail, no dangling cables, no thin antenna, no scope, no magazine separate from gun, no glow spilling outside gun. Whole weapon centered with at least 12 percent margin, one connected object, no hand, no person, no projectile or firing effect. Flat uniform light lavender grey RGB 224 224 232 backdrop, no gradient, no floor, no cast/contact shadow, no stand, no labels or text. Square at least 1024px.
